title: PM shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the spiritual bliss of satsang and devotion
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting how the company of the virtuous gives rise to inspiring discourses that bring joy to the heart and ears, gradually nurturing faith, attachment, and true devotion along the path to liberation. The Prime Minister posted on X: "सतां प्रसङ्गान्मम वीर्यसंविदो भवन्ति हृत्कर्णरसायना: कथा: । तज्जोषणादाश्वपवर्गवर्त्मनि श्रद्धा रतिर्भक्तिरनुक्रमिष्यति॥" सतां प्रसङ्गान्मम वीर्यसंविदो
भवन्ति हृत्कर्णरसायना: कथा: ।

तज्जोषणादाश्वपवर्गवर्त्मनि
श्रद्धा रतिर्भक्तिरनुक्रमिष्यति॥ https://t.co/2o39QQS5O6 — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) November 27, 2026 *** NKRM/SS/SS
